visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with dark hair in pigtails sits on a light-colored wooden floor in a spacious, sunlit living room. An adult's hands, partially visible, hold a large, textured T-Rex toy with its mouth open right in front of the child. The child looks at the dinosaur with wide, curious eyes while another young girl plays near storage bins in the background. (2) The toddler reaches out and tentatively places her small hand into the dinosaur's mouth. After a brief moment of hesitation, she looks up at the camera and breaks into a joyful, gummy smile, showing she is not afraid. The room is decorated with minimalist wooden furniture and toys scattered on the floor. (3) The scene shifts to the toddler sitting on the adult's lap, wearing a cozy beige ribbed sweater and striped socks. The T-Rex 'bites' her hand again, and the toddler scrunches her face into a playful crying expression, though her eyes remain bright and engaged. Her older sister leans in from the side to watch the interaction closely. (4) The dinosaur 'bites' the other sister's hand as well. Both children are now interacting with the toy and the adult. The toddler continues to alternate between a serious, focused face and a laughing one. (5) In a final sequence, the toddler stands up and stares directly at a colorful sensory toy with a stunned, wide-eyed expression. Her mouth is slightly open, and she remains perfectly still as she processes the new object in front of her. The lighting remains bright and natural from a large window.

Background music is an upbeat, bright synth-pop track with a steady electronic drum beat. (2) Sudden vocal sound effects of 'nyum nyum nyum' are performed by the adult to simulate eating, coinciding with the child's reaction. The child makes a soft, happy sound. (3) The child lets out a high-pitched, exaggerated playful wail or scream as the dinosaur 'bites' her. The adult female laughs warmly, and the BGM continues its lively rhythm. (4) More dialogue follows as the adult manages the turn-taking between the two children. The BGM remains constant, providing a joyful atmosphere. (5) A final, short segment features the adult making a surprised exclamation '!!!!' followed by a brief comedic pause. The music swells slightly before a clean hard cut at the end.
